panels.title: Operation rate by gRPC status code

panels.description: Found previous execution statistics (OK) rather than none (NotFound). The scheduler reads these statistics to choose an action's initial size class; an action with none has not run before or has been evicted. A found lookup is not a measure of time saved. Each backend type layer counts the same request again, so the panels read one layer: local_block_device is the storage server; grpc is the client (the scheduler for ISCC, workers for FSAC).
